id: get-reservations-by-demand-ref
title: "Look up every reservation for a demand reference"
description: "Returns every Reservation ever created against a caller-supplied demandRef (an external system's order+line reference, e.g. from order-management). A demandRef can have MULTIPLE reservations across its lifetime — a reservation that was revoked, followed by a successful retry — so this returns a collection, not a single resource; an unknown demandRef returns 200 with an empty `items` array, not 404. The collection is keyset-paginated (REST guideline section 3): one page of `{items, nextCursor}` ordered by (createdAt, id), `limit` (1-500, default 100) and the opaque `cursor` from the previous page's `nextCursor`; `demandRef` is repeated on every page request and `nextCursor` is absent on the last page. Any query parameter other than `demandRef`, `limit` and `cursor` is 400 `unknown-query-parameter` (a retired paging parameter such as `after` fails loudly instead of reading page one forever). This is the read side backing a cross-service order-lifecycle console screen that needs to answer 'what did inventory-storage do for order X, line N'. Side-effect-free."

<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Look up every reservation for a demand reference"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reservations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every Reservation ever created against a caller-supplied demandRef (an external system's order+line reference, e.g. from order-management). A demandRef can have MULTIPLE reservations across its lifetime — a reservation that was revoked, followed by a successful retry — so this returns a collection, not a single resource; an unknown demandRef returns 200 with an empty `items` array, not 404. The collection is keyset-paginated (REST guideline section 3): one page of `{items, nextCursor}` ordered by (createdAt, id), `limit` (1-500, default 100) and the opaque `cursor` from the previous page's `nextCursor`; `demandRef` is repeated on every page request and `nextCursor` is absent on the last page. Any query parameter other than `demandRef`, `limit` and `cursor` is 400 `unknown-query-parameter` (a retired paging parameter such as `after` fails loudly instead of reading page one forever). This is the read side backing a cross-service order-lifecycle console screen that needs to answer "what did inventory-storage do for order X, line N". Side-effect-free.
